summary: No concrete installer-harm evidence; manual review recommended
details: No specific malicious behavior was identified in this package version's scanned contents. The package name resembles a Baileys-derived WhatsApp library fork, a namespace area that has historically seen typosquats and credential-theft variants, but nothing concrete (exfiltration code, install-time fetch+execute, credential collection, dropper, silent relay) was observed in the analyzed files. Without corroborating behavioral evidence, an automated block would be unjustified; routing to human review so a maintainer-trust assessment and deeper inspection of the package's runtime behavior can be performed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
